description: install.json in the state repo (M0.13): what the controller's self-check and the commands' trust rules compare against. Written by `loopctl install write`; installed_at is written by loopctl.

app_login.description: the loop App's commit author, <app-slug>[bot]; null until the App exists (no confirmation is trusted)

engine_ref.description: the engine commit the setup scripts pin

engine_repo.description: the repository the setup scripts install loopctl from (attached to both environments)

page.description: the claude.ai page's artifact slug; null: no page (the control issue is the channel)

workflow_engine.description: where agent-loop.yml gets the engine: engine_repo (production, the App installed on it) or a copy vendored into the target (sandbox: the App is installed on the sandbox repositories only)
